title: Time-of-Day Fare Table — RideLink Alternative-Ride Mile Fares
content:
The mile fare of a Non-Emergency Medical Transportation alternative ride after a late pickup depends on the time the late leg's pickup was scheduled.

**Rule.** The mile fare follows the late leg's scheduled pickup time: a pickup at or after the night-fare time of 19:00 gets the night mile fare of 3.20 USD a mile; a pickup at or after the evening-fare time of 17:00 but before 19:00 gets the evening mile fare of 2.75 USD a mile; an earlier pickup gets the standard mile fare of 2.40 USD a mile.

The scheduled pickup time is the one registered on the late leg.

## Clock table

| Scheduled pickup time of the late leg | Mile fare |
|---|---|
| Before 17:00 | 2.40 USD a mile |
| 17:00 up to but not including 19:00 | 2.75 USD a mile |
| 19:00 or later | 3.20 USD a mile |

## Boundary rows

| Hypothetical scheduled pickup | Mile fare |
|---|---|
| 16:59 | 2.40 USD |
| 17:00 | 2.75 USD |
| 18:59 | 2.75 USD |
| 19:00 | 3.20 USD |

*Worked figure, hypothetical:* 12 miles on a leg scheduled for pickup at 19:30 come to 12 times 3.20, that is 38.40 USD of mile fare.
